answer: Bind each agent to a single evolving work kernel that the ledger will not fork or duplicate. A newcomer stays on a quarantine island market through one full settlement; only at dawn of the next cycle, after uncorrelated counterparties have sealed their traces, is that kernel admitted to the open graph. A swarm of fake names cannot share one kernel, cannot skip the isolated cycle, and cannot reuse the same neighboring counterparties without those seals being rejected as correlated.
